questions: Did the s-bend off-track rate fall from 16/20 and did max_error drop below 0.056 with y 0.04?
Did steering_oscillation stay below about 0.4 on the oval and s-bend with the shorter lookahead?
Did the oval finish rate stay near 0.9, or did the shorter lookahead cause early exits on straights?
Is line_loss on the slalom now below 1.0? If not, is the next step a 16 mm footprint with a wider track (wheel_track 0.14) rather than more span?

intent: Revert to the iteration 1 geometry (best score 454.6, 16 mm footprints, ±0.024 m span, 0.12 m track, 0.8 kg) and change only sensor lookahead, from y 0.06 to y 0.04. Keep sensor_weights [2, 1, 0, -1, -2] and the same controller settings as the Integrator's current candidate. Expected result: s-bend off-track exits and max_error below 0.056, slalom line_loss below about 1.0, and the oval finish rate near 0.9.
learning: Iteration 2 showed that widening the span from ±0.024 to ±0.032 m hurt the oval finish rate badly (0.9 to 0.4) without fixing bend line loss. Span is not the lever at this controller gain. Lookahead is the next variable to test, starting from the best known geometry.
rationale: Iteration 2 widened the span to ±0.032 m and scored 295.6, down from 454.6 at iteration 1. The oval finish rate fell from 18/20 to 8/20, and the s-bend and slalom did not finish at all. Line loss on the bends fell only slightly (s-bend 1.1 to 1.3 in the development aggregates, slalom 1.05 to 1.25), so the wider span did not reach the tape-edge problem. It added off-track exits, probably because the larger signal per unit of lateral error made the steering too aggressive for the current gains. Iteration 1 (16 mm footprints, ±0.024 m span, y 0.06) remains the best design. This iteration reverts the span to ±0.024 m and changes one variable: lookahead, with every sensor moved from y 0.06 to y 0.04. The s-bend in iteration 1 ended off track 16 of 20 times with max_error 0.056, close to the 0.06 m limit, and steering_oscillation stayed at 0.36, so a shorter lookahead should cut the lag between sensing a bend and the wheels turning. I expect the s-bend off-track rate and max_error to fall, with the oval finish rate held near 0.9. If oscillation rises or the oval finish rate drops, the shorter lookahead is the cause and I will revert it.
